d:
Bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ki pahal ke bad gopashtami mela ke aamantran patr men bara badlav kiya gaya hai. ab is karyakram ke lie sansad rajesh varma ko bhi aupcharik nimantran bheja gaya hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
